scope: Recover the saved Voimatalo candidate using its original GLB and declaration. This bounded task concerns the mesh-to-BIM coordinate frame and exterior alignment, not a full rebuilding. Start with inspect_candidate(seed, include_geometry=False) to read its assumptions and floor IDs. Register the old stated frame explicitly if needed to inspect the baseline. Choose your own native mesh views and surface-direction evidence, using independent local near-vertical surfaces to establish a defensible frame; no new angle or fitted target is supplied. Use the saved-source overlay to compare before/after placement and make a substantive, evidenced registration correction if supported. Preserve existing numerical room/opening geometry for this controlled frame recovery; mark residual shape, height, courtyard openings and vertical-connectivity defects rather than silently fixing or certifying them. Update obsolete coordinate assumptions while retaining other unresolved limitations. Inspect actual overlays in top and side views before selecting a candidate; no internal truth or surveyed fidelity claim. No EnergyPlus.
only_input: Admitted original GLB and optional original PNGs, explicit building declaration, user scope and optional saved proposal. Mesh views are generated on demand internally; no GT/evaluation or preselected camera package.

declaration.use: office with street-level commercial, from previously sourced input preparation
declaration.storey_information: Prior public record describes eight above-ground storeys including six similar office storeys and a setback upper storey; reconcile with visual evidence. Not actual surveyed slab levels.
declaration.simplification_intent: Retain main shape, storeys, setbacks and visible aperture groups. Infer a useful, moderately detailed office/circulation/service-space scheme from available constraints. Do not make room counts a goal or split a continuous open space just by orientation. No internal plan is supplied; all interior partition/door hypotheses must be explicit.
declaration.input_condition: Original self-contained GLB of the previously selected target single building. The prior single-building crop is retained and may omit occluded/context surfaces. No prepared screenshots, facade plane selections, local alignment angle, prior BIM, window coordinates/counts or interior plan is supplied in this run. View and measure the asset through tools as needed.

building_input.image_path_policy: Declared paths are provenance labels only. They are associated by exact basename with the already authorized PNG inventory and are never opened as file paths.

field_semantics.thermal_zones: User declaration for downstream simulation zoning; it is not a measured or authoritative count of physical source spaces.
field_semantics.other_fields: User-supplied building declarations retain their stated meaning and are not ground truth or independently verified observations.

building_input.conflict_policy: The agent must compare declarations with supplied drawing evidence, preserve the conflict or uncertainty, and decide its modelling effect explicitly.

source_coordinate_transform.order: scene node transform, then glTF Y-up to BIM Z-up, then operation yaw

geometry.selection_caveat: A bounded centroid selection can hide intersecting or occluding surfaces; it is an observation filter, not evidence of enclosure truth.
geometry.evidence_caveat: Bounds and counts describe the supplied surface mesh only; they do not establish floors, rooms, enclosure, or a true footprint.

mesh_input.note: Original mesh asset; no preselected cameras or BIM observations. Mesh surfaces may be incomplete/noisy and are not room semantics.
